ops.old: Baby carrots, snow peas, radishes and cucumber spears around a whipped feta, lemon and dill dip finished with olive oil and chilli flakes. Blitz 200g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt, the zest and juice of half a lemon and 2 tbsp olive oil until smooth. Stir through 2 tbsp chopped dill. Spread into a shallow bowl, drizzle with more oil and scatter with chilli flakes. Trim 1 bunch baby carrots, 150g snow peas and 1 bunch radishes, cut 1 continental cucumber into spears, and stand everything in ice water for 10 minutes to crisp up. Drain well and arrange neatly around the dip.
